notes: Aggregate state is owner-backed summarized truth or projection, not a bag of invented hidden individuals.
Refinement partitions or promotes only what governing owner rules can support; it cannot fabricate exact personal history from aggregate outcomes.
Persistent identities are minted only by canonical identity owners and survive later simulation-detail collapse.

Representation coverage explicitly prevents the same person, creature, resource or capacity from being counted simultaneously as both an aggregate remainder and an individualized member when the owner semantics are exclusive.
Offscreen advancement uses canonical Campaign/event bounds and may batch only through declared aggregate rules with replay/provenance receipts.
Performance budgets may reduce presentation/simulation fidelity, defer work or request GM adjudication, but cannot skip required owner commits or invent a convenient result.
Family-level tranche reductions remain deferred until complete family PDCP disposition reviews.
